title: Skydive Buckeye

services.name: Learn To Skydive
services.desc: After the first tandem skydive, many people are interested in learning how to skydive. The A license is the first license a skydiver achieves. This license is proof that the skydiver has completed their training and is qualified to jump without supervision. A skydiver with an A license has learned about all of the equipment, knows how to safely exit the aircraft, how to position their bodies in free fall, how to fly the parachute during their descent and landing, and what to do if things do not go as planned. Complete all requirements on the USPA A License Proficiency Card. This includes: Skydive Buckeye is a family owned skydiving center. We are located 30 minutes west of Phoenix, Arizona.

services.name: First Time Skydiving
services.desc: Upon arrival, you will be greeted by one of our friendly staff members. After filling out the required paperwork and providing a valid ID, you will meet your tandem instructor. He is going to show you what to do during the skydive and answer any questions you may have. After brief training, it’s time to gear up and head for the plane. There is no need to panic! The tandem instructor is the one responsible for handling all the equipment. Take in the views on a 15-20 minute plane ride to roughly 2 miles in the air.
